name: mask4-layout baseline
hypothesis: This rebuilds the only family that scored above 0. The legal mask goes in under 4 index layouts plus coordinates, followed by a 1x1 stem and a residual 3x3 trunk. Per-type logit maps are re-laid in the same 4 layouts and summed, so the network can learn how this world maps action indices to cells. I expect a dev score of at least 0.1. If both seeds score 0, this world breaks its description beyond flips and transposes.
